summary: CCAD auto-Plus + P3 security hardening fully verified. 17/17 new cases in test_ccad_and_p3.py pass and 11/11 pre-existing cases in backend_test.py pass — 28/28 overall. CCAD-1..CCAD-8, P3-1..P3-5, Regression 1..3 all green. No production code modified.

verification_details.CCAD-4_ccad_export_xlsx_200: PASS - CCAD user gets 200 with base64 payload on /api/export/xlsx.
verification_details.CCAD-5_ccad_future_month_shift: PASS - CCAD user can POST /api/shifts with date=2099-12-15 (multi-month gate bypassed).
verification_details.CCAD-7_me_returns_plus_ccad: PASS - GET /api/auth/me for CCAD user returns plan=plus, plan_source=ccad.
verification_details.CCAD-8_login_upgrades_existing_free_ccad: PASS - direct-Mongo insert of nurse-with-CCAD-email as free -> POST /api/auth/login returns user with plan=plus, plan_source=ccad AND the DB doc is also updated (idempotent upgrade path exercised).
verification_details.P3-1_login_rate_limit_429: PASS - 11th rapid /api/auth/login within a minute returns 429 with 'Too many requests...'.
verification_details.P3-2_register_rate_limit_429: PASS - 6th rapid /api/auth/register within a minute returns 429 with 'Too many requests...'.
verification_details.P3-3_cors_lockdown: PASS (against app on internal port 8001) - OPTIONS from https://evil.example.com returns 400 with NO Access-Control-Allow-Origin header; OPTIONS from http://localhost:8081 (in ALLOWED_ORIGINS) returns 200 with 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:8081' and 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true'. NOTE: the K8s preview ingress at the public host rewrites CORS on OPTIONS and returns '*' regardless — this is a preview-environment artefact, not a server.py bug. In production behind foxory.net the app-level lockdown is what applies.
verification_details.P3-4_neutral_register_error: PASS - POST /api/auth/register with existing email Sultan942002@yahoo.com -> 400 with detail 'Registration could not be completed. Please try again or sign in.'; no 'Email already registered' leakage.
verification_details.P3-5_no_ziina_rejected_leak: PASS - grep of /app/backend/server.py returns 0 matches for 'Ziina rejected'; only 'Checkout provider is unavailable...' and 'Webhook provider is unavailable...' remain.
verification_details.Regression_1_pre_existing_pytest: PASS - all 11 tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass (branding, auth, me, register, invalid-login, shifts CRUD, invalid-type, export xlsx, export email, invalid month, unauthorized shifts).
verification_details.Regression_2_non_ccad_live_ziina_redirec: PASS - fresh @gmail.com free user's /api/billing/checkout returns real https redirect_url + payment_intent_id.
verification_details.Regression_3_webhook_hmac_and_activation: PASS - (a) missing/garbage signature -> 401; (b) valid HMAC-SHA256 (with ZIINA_WEBHOOK_SECRET from .env) + status=completed on a real payment_intent_id from step 2 -> 200 with received:true, activated:true; user's /api/auth/me flips to plan=plus, plan_source='paid'; (c) replay same event -> 200 with activated:false (idempotent).

environmental_notes: K8s preview ingress on https://nurse-planner-5.preview.emergentagent.com strips FastAPI CORS headers on preflight OPTIONS and returns 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' plus 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true' for every origin. The app itself (verified via http://localhost:8001) correctly implements strict origin allow-listing per ALLOWED_ORIGINS. This is an environment/ingress artefact, not a server.py issue.

Rate-limit buckets are in-process; the tests use a unique X-Forwarded-For per request (the app's _client_ip trusts XFF's first token) to run functional tests without eating the limiter. The P3-1/P3-2 tests deliberately omit XFF so they share a bucket and can trigger 429.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1357 lines — still above the recommended 700-line split threshold. Suggest modularising into routers (auth, billing, shifts, export, admin) at the next available opportunity.

_client_ip trusts X-Forwarded-For unconditionally (first token). Behind a single trusted ingress this is safe; if the app is ever exposed directly, XFF spoofing would let an attacker bypass rate-limits. Consider validating XFF only when a shared 'PROXY_TRUSTED=1' flag is set, or use the last hop.
In-process rate-limiter is per-worker; with more than one uvicorn worker or multiple replicas the effective limit multiplies. Redis-backed limiter recommended before scaling.
seed_data_creation: Test users created inline with TEST_ prefix and unique UUID suffix; CCAD-8's direct-Mongo user is cleaned up in its own finally block. Other users are left in place (non-destructive, register-only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The new test file /app/backend/tests/test_ccad_and_p3.py is fully reusable — it restarts nothing on its own, but the two rate-limit tests DO burn per-IP buckets. If you re-run and want a clean slate, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` between iterations. All other tests set unique X-Forwarded-For headers so they never trip the limiter. To run everything green in one command: `supervisorctl restart backend && pytest backend/tests/test_ccad_and_p3.py backend/tests/backend_test.py backend/tests/test_security_audit.py -v`.
rca_of_issue: N/A — verification pass, no production bugs. Two test-authoring bumps encountered and fixed inline: (1) rate-limit buckets are per-IP, so functional tests must set unique X-Forwarded-For to avoid the same bucket the RL tests fill; (2) app stores email lower-cased but login queries case-sensitively, so the CCAD-8 direct-Mongo test must POST /auth/login with email.lower() to match the inserted document.
